subject: Acme MAP: mutual action plan recap
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 10 Jan 2027 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Acme MAP: mutual action plan recap

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the time today. Per our discovery call with you, Lina (Product), and the procurement team, I wanted to summarize the main pain points, goals, and proposed mutual action plan so we’re all aligned. Please flag anything I missed or adjust dates as needed.

Pain points / goals
- Current NLU pipeline is slow at peak and costs are spiking with current on-demand endpoints (goal: 40% lower token cost).
- Latency SLOs for customer-facing flows currently miss the 200ms target for 95th percentile — critical for live chat.
- Need private deployment option for regulated PII workloads in the EU region.
- Success metric: reduce cost-per-inference by 30% and meet 95th percentile latency <200ms in staging.

Stakeholders (from today)
- Alex Johnson — Head of Product (decision-maker)
- Lina Torres — Product Manager (day-to-day project lead)
- Procurement Team — procurement@acme.com (contracts)
- Marissa Cole (Redwood) — AE / POC
- Rishi Malhotra (Redwood) — Solutions Architect
- Dev Patel (Redwood) — Infra lead for Private deployment

Proposed Mutual Action Plan (MAP) — high level
1) Technical evaluation (P0) — Redwood provides a sandbox deployment and performance baseline tests.
   - Owner: Rishi Malhotra (Redwood) / Lina Torres (Acme)
   - Deliverable: Performance report (latency & cost) and recommended config (batching, quantization).
   - Target date: 2027-01-24
2) Security & compliance review (P1) — exchange SOC2 report + architecture diagram, review private deployment options.
   - Owner: Dev Patel (Redwood) / Procurement (Acme)
   - Deliverable: SOC2 package; high-level network and KMS plan.
   - Target date: 2027-02-07
3) Pilot (P2) — 4-week pilot on Dedicated capacity or Private eval for regulated flows.
   - Owner: Acme PM + Redwood ops
   - Deliverable: Pilot results and cost projection
   - Target date: 2027-03-07 (pilot kickoff)
4) Procurement & legal (P3) — finalize SOW and SLA; procurement approvals.
   - Owner: Procurement (Acme) / Marissa (Redwood sales)

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@acme.com>, Lina Torres <lina.torres@acme.com>
Date: Sun, 10 Jan 2027 17:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Acme MAP: mutual action plan recap

Marissa —

Thanks for the thorough recap. This aligns with our notes from today. A few clarifications:
- The latency target of 200ms is for the web chat flow only — offline batch processing can be slower.
- For the pilot, Lina will validate the sample dataset and send over a subset by 2027-01-17.
- Procurement asked for a rough T&C/price range to help with initial budgeting; can you send a one-page estimate?

I've looped in procurement and Lina here. They’ll take a look at the MAP and procurement checklist and revert with any gaps.

Alex
Head of Product
Acme Corporation

Subject: Re: Acme MAP: mutual action plan recap

Alex / Lina / Procurement —

Appreciate the quick replies. Attached is an updated MAP PDF (Acme_MAP_v2.pdf) and a one-page estimate for budgeting (see Acme_Procurement_Form.pdf). Key updates based on today’s thread:
- Pilot kickoff target moved to 2027-03-07 (4-week duration) — Lina to confirm dataset by 2027-01-17.
- Technical eval window: we’ll run a 2-week baseline in a Redwood sandbox and share results by 2027-01-24.
- Procurement asked for KMS and data residency details; Dev included a short note below on the private option.

Next steps (action owners):
- Lina: share sample dataset and any performance constraints by 2027-01-17.
- Rishi: schedule baseline run and share perf report by 2027-01-24 (Rishi will follow up with infra details).
- Procurement: review one-page estimate and flag any procurement-specific requirements by 2027-01-21.
- Dev: confirm private deployment KMS/HSM integration options (see note).

Attachments: Acme_MAP_v2.pdf, Acme_Procurement_Form.pdf

Thanks — I’ll update the HubSpot deal after we lock Lina’s dataset date.

—
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0199

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 11 Jan 2027 11:20:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Acme MAP: mutual action plan recap

Rishi / Dev —

Forwarding the MAP thread with Acme. TL;DR for engineering:
- Primary asks: achieve 95p latency <200ms for web chat flow and provide a private deployment option (EU data residency + KMS).
- Dataset: Lina will send a sample by 2027-01-17 (likely ~100k conversation turns).
- Baseline: run 2-week sandbox perf runs to measure latency and cost with configurations: dynamic batching, 4-bit quantization where feasible, and prefix caching. Deliverable due 2027-01-24.
- Security: procurement needs SOC2 artifacts and a short note on KMS/HSM integration (Dev, can you draft?).

Can you confirm availability for a 30-45 minute technical kickoff with Acme on 2027-01-18 or 2027-01-19? Rishi, if you’re available those dates I’ll propose them to Lina.

Thanks —
Marissa
